correctness.rationale: Representing derivations by f and imposing f f′=0 is exact in characteristic two; valuation parity gives exhaustive necessary and sufficient coefficient vanishing. The stated coordinate spaces are all dimension floor(N/2), are distinct and have the nested adjacent-hyperplane incidence relation, giving c*q^m-(c-1)*q^(m-1). The coefficient of t in f f′ is f_1^2 and no linear f_1 relation exists after the odd-N f_0 restriction; this proves nonreducedness and tangent dimension. A standalone independent checker passed 22 exhaustive finite-field configurations; the proof is general.

value.rationale: The object is the intrinsic restricted-square stratum of the derivation Lie algebra (equivalently height-one additive actions) on every truncated monogenic local algebra in characteristic two. Its linear-component number grows with N, gives a structural equidimensional/reducible phenomenon and a uniform finite-field census, with a genuine nilpotent parameter scheme. Not a selected numerical slice; independent of computations in small fields.
